description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Wind Ability Boost, Triplecast Wind, Unlimited Wind Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Wind Abilities, Wind Ability Damage +30% & 20% DEF/RES Pierce to Wind Abilities; Ends after using 8 Wind abilities
TP Max: AOE Wind/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: War-Awoken Hellstorm Spear (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Wind/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Wind Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has at least Lv.0/2 En-Wind
WS Blue: [Lv.2 En-Wind Stack]
WS Gold: [During Tactical Awoken Mode, Dualcast Wind 2 & Instant Wind 2]
